Status update on the pending spec PRs:
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5864
  PR is ready to be merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5863
  There was no feedback on the desired initial 4844 throughput levels. I think the values proposed by the PR - 0.25/0.5 MB (target/limit) - would be a sensible choice, so if there are no other opinions, we could merge this.
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5862
  Some discussion, no consensus reached yet. Will remain open for now.

EIP-4844 for EthereumJS has been started here https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/2349 by @acolytec3. We are relatively early on, will try to join the call today, eventually Andrew as well.

Some remaining spec todos on the consensus layer networking end
https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/3088
